title: TSM L1: Governed Technician Intelligence
story: UNDERSTAND > PREPARE > VERIFY > TECHNICIAN CONFIRMS > EXECUTE AND RECORD > HANDOFF
businessPain: Ticket context is scattered across incidents, asset records and procedures, so technicians rebuild it by hand and close work on inconsistent evidence.
valueProposition: Governed technician assistance: AI prepares, a technician authorizes, and closure is gated on recorded evidence.
desc: Captured fail-loud from the real L1 Ticket Copilot: every step must change the screen or the capture stops. Lookups use demo records; ServiceNow is not connected. No engine output is stubbed.
_note: Frames come from capture-l1-flagship-v3.js (32 steps). Captions and narration describe only what each v3 step asserts; see l1-flagship-v3-capture.json for the on-screen gate text. stage indexes chain. Narration numbers are written as words. Previous v2-keyed manifest is preserved as l1-v2.json.

states.caption: Enterprise Command Center
states.narration: This is the TSM Enterprise Command Center, where IT operations work starts. Everything you will see runs in the real application, against demo records.
states.promoNarration: TSM L one. Governed technician intelligence, running in the real application.

states.caption: Copilot assistant, one click away
states.narration: The copilot assistant is one click away from the command center.

states.caption: L1 Ticket Copilot
states.narration: A technician opens the L one Ticket Copilot. The problem it targets: ticket context is scattered across incidents, asset records and procedures, and every technician pieces it together differently.
states.promoNarration: The problem: ticket context is scattered, and every technician pieces it together differently.

states.caption: Offboarding ticket entered
states.narration: An offboarding ticket arrives. A departing employee's laptop has to come back to inventory, and its device record has to be updated.

states.caption: Classified as offboarding; closure blocked
states.narration: TSM reads the ticket text and classifies it as offboarding. It sets the next action, and it shows closure as blocked, because the required evidence isn't there yet. The technician knows what is missing before doing anything.
states.promoCaption: Understand: next action and closure readiness
states.promoNarration: TSM classifies the ticket, sets the next action, and shows closure blocked until the evidence is in.

states.caption: Asset tag entered for recovery
states.narration: To verify the return, the technician enters the laptop's asset tag.

states.caption: Asset record found (demo data)
states.narration: TSM looks up the asset record. This environment uses demo records, and the screen says so.

states.caption: Outcome: returned to stock
states.narration: The technician records the outcome: returned to stock.

states.caption: Technician confirms the return
states.narration: And confirms it personally. A person attests to the physical return. The system does not assume it.

states.caption: Asset recovery verified
states.narration: Asset recovery is verified.

states.caption: Asset Lifecycle workspace
states.narration: Next, the asset record itself has to change. The technician moves to Asset Lifecycle.

states.caption: Incident, asset and return reason filled
states.narration: The incident, the asset, the technician, and the reason for the return are filled in.

states.caption: Recommendation: Return to Inventory (draft only)
states.narration: The assistant recommends Return to Inventory, at medium confidence, and labels it as draft assistance only. It recommends. It does not act.
states.promoNarration: The assistant recommends Return to Inventory, labelled as a draft. It recommends. It does not act.

states.caption: Technician authorizes the action
states.narration: Nothing changes until the technician authorizes it. That boundary is the point: the AI prepares, a person decides.
states.promoNarration: Nothing changes until the technician authorizes it.

states.caption: Action confirmed and recorded
states.narration: The action is confirmed, and the confirmation is recorded.
states.promoNarration: The action is confirmed and recorded.

states.caption: Resolution builder
states.narration: From here the technician can draft the resolution note from the evidence gathered so far.

states.caption: Tier 2 escalation builder
states.narration: Or, if the work needs Tier two, build an escalation package, so the next team doesn't start from scratch.

states.caption: Closure evidence checklist
states.narration: Back on the ticket, closure requires explicit evidence.

states.caption: User verified
states.narration: The user is verified,

states.caption: Work confirmed
states.narration: the work is confirmed,

states.caption: Tested
states.narration: the fix is tested,

states.caption: Final work note confirmed
states.narration: and the final work note is confirmed.

states.caption: Closure still blocked: location not verified
states.narration: TSM re-evaluates, and closure is still blocked. The location hasn't been verified, so the ticket cannot close on incomplete evidence. The gate holds even when everything else looks done.
states.promoNarration: Closure stays blocked until the location is verified. The ticket cannot close on incomplete evidence.

states.caption: Second ticket: software request
states.narration: A different ticket: a software install request. TSM classifies it as a software task, and the required steps change with it.
states.promoNarration: A software request gets different required steps, automatically.

states.caption: Request number entered
states.narration: The technician enters the request number.

states.caption: Request found (demo data)
states.narration: TSM finds the request, again from demo records.

states.caption: Outcome: fulfilled
states.narration: Outcome: fulfilled.

states.caption: Software installed: confirmed
states.narration: The technician confirms the software is installed,

states.caption: Technician confirms fulfillment
states.narration: and attests to the fulfillment.

states.caption: Fulfillment verified
states.narration: Fulfillment is verified.

states.caption: L1 executive view
states.narration: Leadership sees the same work from the L one executive view.
states.promoNarration: Leadership sees the same work in the executive view.

states.caption: Back at the Command Center
states.narration: The same loop, every ticket: understand the ticket, prepare the action, verify it, a technician confirms, the result is recorded, and the work hands off cleanly. The aim is consistency: less avoidable re-investigation, and evidence you can audit.
states.promoNarration: Understand, prepare, verify, a technician confirms, and the result is recorded. The aim: consistent work, and evidence you can audit.
